_comment: Names registered by the NATIVE layer (Mewjector + mewframework) that are not present in base game data. The validator treats these as valid status/ability/component references so data mods that pair with a native mod validate. Seeded with JokersLuck so mods/jokers-luck validates. Add a native mod's registered names here (plain strings, or {"name","kind","mod"} objects). An entry with a "pattern" (a regular expression) is a name the framework recognises by its SHAPE, with no registration and no mod DLL: kind "glow" = a status named FwGlow_<rrggbb> or FwGlow_<rrggbbaa> gives its carrier a coloured rim (fw_glow_rules.h, docs/data-mods.md "Asking for a unit glow from data"); "prefix" marks the namespace, so a malformed FwGlow_ name is reported as invalid-glow-name. "name" is only a label there. kind "catrig" (framework API v5) is a SWF export shape, not a GON name: a SymbolClass export _CatRig_<CharacterEntry> in a mod SWF replaces that one entry's cat clip (CatTest) with the export (fw_catrig_rules.h, docs/data-mods.md "A whole cat rig for one character"); the validator checks that <CharacterEntry> exists (cat-rig-target-unknown). Kind "model" is a 3D model a native mod registers with the mesh engine: it only resolves a GON graphics.model "@Name" reference (docs/data-mods.md "3D models in a mod (preview)"), never a status/ability/character.
